headline: Full Stack Engineer · TypeScript / NestJS / Next.js / PostgreSQL
summary: Full Stack Engineer with 3.5 years shipping production web products in TypeScript, React and Node.js (NestJS) on PostgreSQL — most recently a licensed multi-market sportsbook and casino platform, and before that a casino lootbox game built from scratch and delivered through a gamification platform to live players. I own features end to end, from data model and API through UI, tests and CI/CD, including real-time updates over WebSocket and Redis-backed shared state. Daily development with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) under test-and-review guardrails.

cover_letter.intro: I'm Anton — a fullstack developer with 3.5 years of experience in TypeScript, React and NestJS, and I'd love to be considered for the Full-Stack Developer role at Acme iGaming.
cover_letter.snapshot: Quick snapshot: a year of end-to-end work on a casino lootbox game — a NestJS backend on hexagonal architecture with PostgreSQL, Redis and an event bus, real-time updates over WebSocket and the provably-fair reveal its operating licence requires, delivered through a gamification platform into a live casino site. Today I ship features into the shared React + TypeScript frontend of a licensed sportsbook and casino, including its migration to React 19.
cover_letter.before: Before that: a polyglot microservice platform tracking game and casino performance, where I built a Python ETL service and worked with Elasticsearch, MongoDB and RabbitMQ — so iGaming isn't a new domain for me, it's most of my track record.
cover_letter.proof: And the first thing I ever shipped — a student platform on NestJS and Prisma — is still in production, serving up to ~500 concurrent users.
